_comment: Published per WP-SCP-022 020H.1 (closes 020H part 3 (xi) freshness-warning forward-looking flag). The reusable workflow's freshness-warning step compares this manifest at SCP main HEAD against the manifest at the wrapper's SHA pin (in .scp-runtime/version-manifest.json) and emits ::warning:: when the wrapper is more than `freshness_warning_threshold_minor` minor versions behind. The threshold is read from the PINNED manifest, not from main HEAD (closes 020H.1 R1 SAFE-MIN-006). Bump `version` + `minor` + `released_at` together on every release. See policies/VERSIONING.md for the semver contract. v1.5.0 introduces WP-SCP-028 Phase 1 (D-058 first auth domain) — three new domain rules: SCP-R-009 (auth-canonical-version-pin), SCP-R-010 (auth-canonical-import-fence; two-tier), SCP-R-011 (auth-contract-claim-shape); all warn-baseline. Additive-rule MINOR. The rules ship loaded but vacuous-pass in production until a companion workflow PR materialises input.canonical_sdk_versions + input.auth_contract (cosign-verified via the .sig.bundle anchor) + input.adopter_* into the evaluation envelope and adds them to WARN_BASELINE_RULES (the SCP-R-006/R-030 safe-failure precedent). D-059 reserved for the post-4-week-observation deny-promotion outcome. (v1.4.0 was WP-SCP-030 Phase B.1 / SCP-R-030.)
_schema_note: No JSON Schema $schema URL — version-manifest.json is a load-bearing public surface (every adopter wrapper at 020H.1+ reads this at workflow run time) but the shape is small and stable; fields are documented in policies/VERSIONING.md and ADOPT-001 §12.7.11. If the surface grows, file a schema at schemas/version-manifest.schema.json (closes 020H.1 R1 COR-MANIFEST-002).
